source: final candidate native child transcripts and installed source guide

findings.observed: A frame-derived SVG rotate(-90 cx cy) on a progress circle was rejected because the complete template literal was not statically constant.
findings.classification: conservative false positive: shape rotation does not shrink text
findings.fixBoundary: Recognize numeric 2D transform arguments; retain rejection of unknown operations and shrinking text transforms.

findings.observed: A g containing a literal array mapped through a block callback to rect graphics was treated as possible visible text. Adding fontSize to g had no visual effect.
findings.classification: conservative false positive: structural JSX return was not recognized
findings.fixBoundary: Prove common JSX-only return structures; keep bare text and unknown returns subject to text size checks.

findings.observed: Two original Scene workers received missing explicit container font-size failures and corrected their own output before successful commit.
findings.classification: Recorded worker rework; final success alone does not establish whether each original container had real text.
findings.fixBoundary: Do not infer zero unsuccessful calls from a passing first-use receipt.

findings.observed: Default templates used fixed dark foregrounds on transparent roots; the light preview backing was absent when composed over a dark GlobalVisual base.
findings.classification: rendered visual issue not covered by font-size checks
findings.fixBoundary: Provide local opaque foreground backing without adding a full-frame Scene background; validate on dark and light composed backgrounds.

limitations: This incident is not a pass receipt.
Source checks do not certify rendered contrast, clipping, or listening quality.
Historical attempts and installed packages remain unchanged.
